domSnapshot.bodyTextSample: Skip to main content searchmaterial_design Home apps Get started code Develop book Foundations palette Styles add_circle Components pages Blog play_arrow pause dark_mode light_mode Get StartedGet to know Material 3 – from UX guidance and tools to reusable components and open-source codeWhat's Material?Learn how Material enables beautiful product design at Google scaleWhat's Material 3 Expressive?Explore new features, components, and tactics for emotionally impactful UXUsing MaterialGet to know Material.io and our top resourcesDesignStart applying color, type, adaptive design patterns, and moreDevelopDeveloper resources include code for Android, Flutter, and the WebWhat's Material?Learn how Material enables beautiful product design at Google scaleWhat's Material 3 Expressive?Explore new features, components, and tactics for emotionally impactful UXUsing MaterialGet to know Material.io and our top resourcesDesignStart applying color, type, adaptive design patterns, and moreDevelopDeveloper resources include code for Android, Flutter, and the WebpauseWhat's Material?Material Design is a design system built and supported by Google designers and developers. Material.io includes in-depth UX guidance and UI component implementations for Android, Flutter, and the Web. The latest version, Material 3, enables personal, adaptive, and expressive experiences – from dynamic color and enhanced accessibility, to foundations for large screen layouts and design tokens. M3 Expressive takes this a step further by adding more flexible components, vibrant styles, and fully integrated motion. All Material 3 content, guidelines, imagery, and resources are available under the Apache 2.0 or CC BY 4.0 license.UX foundationsFoundations like color, type, and shape are customizable systems in MaterialbookOpen-source codeMulti-platform code to build beautiful products, fastercodeTutorials, case studies & newsFollow Material's blog for updates, deep dives, and morepagespauseWhat's Material 3 Expressive?People increasingly see their devices as extensions of themselves. Expressive UIs have an emotional impact, fostering this connection by evoking a stronger feeling or mood with the device. M3 Expressive is an expansion of the Material 3 design system. It’s a set of new features, updated components, and design tactics for creating emotionally impactful UX.Expressive components15 new or updated components featuring more sizes, shapes, functionality, visual emphasis, and other expressive updatesEmphasized typographyExpanded M3 type scale with new emphasized styles, and guidelines for how to craft stunning editorial moments using variable fontsMotion physics systemNew, simplified spring-based system to make interactions and transitions feel more alive, fluid, and naturalExpanded shape library35 shapes to add decorative detail and shape morphing to image crops, avatars, loading indicators, and general progresspauseUsing MaterialOn Material.io, the design system is organized in three main parts: foundations, styles, and components.
